name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: This role asks for someone who owns a demand-gen channel end to end and can prove it moved pipeline, not just activity. At Solenzo I've run that exact motion: outbound and email, built and owned personally, from targeting to the booked meeting.

I built the outbound and email channel in GoHighLevel from the ground up, segmented cold-email campaigns, an automated audit workflow that enrolled 180+ businesses, and appointment booking with confirmation, reminders, and no-show recovery, 20+ workflows total. At Level Agency I built the ROI, CAC, and LTV reporting that turned channel activity into a number sales could act on. Earlier, at Fetch & Funnel and Accelo, I sat on the other side of that handoff, closing deals sourced through exactly this kind of pipeline, so I know what a qualified meeting needs to look like before an AE will trust it.

Most of my channel-ownership work has been as the person who also closes the deal, not handing qualified meetings to a separate SDR or AE team, so partnering as a co-equal with a dedicated sales org is the one piece of this role I'd be building fresh rather than repeating. Everything else, channel ownership, funnel optimization, reporting discipline, is proven. I'd welcome the conversation.
